final: WITH per AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x, SUM(s.aream2) * 1.0 / SUM(s.volm3) AS area_to_volume FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_atv FROM per WHERE area_to_volume IS NOT NULL) SELECT per.fundflux, per.avg_y_vs_x, per.area_to_volume, per.area_to_volume - overall.avg_atv AS above_average FROM per, overall WHERE per.area_to_volume > overall.avg_atv
